The decisive mistake was the Orchestrator's hand-off to FileSurfer at step 17.

WebSurfer had already opened the article PDF at step 12 and only needed to scroll to the passage with the quoted word. When WebSurfer hit an error at step 14–15, the Orchestrator treated that as a loop. It then sent FileSurfer to open a "downloaded PDF" that had never been downloaded, so FileSurfer returned a 404 for /workspace/76.pdf. The Orchestrator repeated the same instruction at step 21 with the same result. The run ended with the wrong answer "tricksy" instead of "fluffy".

AGENT: Orchestrator (-> FileSurfer)
STEP: 17
